en: The postcard depicts a large historic building with a tall, distinctive tower, partially obscured by tall evergreen trees. The structure features multiple geometric rooflines and a mix of architectural elements, suggesting Northern or Central European design, possibly from the early 20th century. The scene is set in a wooded area, indicating the building is likely situated in a park or forest.
